description: This file contains utility functions and classes related to fake tensor handling, tensor aliasing checks, and a custom Torch dispatch mode used for testing or debugging fake tensors within the PyTorch library.

classes.name: CrossRefFakeMode
classes.description: A custom TorchDispatchMode that performs cross-referencing checks between real and fake tensors during tensor operations for consistency verification.

methods.name: bool outputs_alias_inputs(outputs: PyTree, inputs: PyTree)
methods.description: Checks if any outputs alias the inputs by sharing the same storage in a given PyTree of tensors.

methods.name: bool outputs_are_inputs(outputs: PyTree, inputs: PyTree)
methods.description: Checks if any outputs are actually the same objects as the inputs based on their identity.

methods.name: bool output_alias_each_other(outputs: PyTree)
methods.description: Determines if outputs share storage with each other, indicating aliasing among outputs.

methods.name: None _check_alias_info( context: str, real_out: PyTree, real_in: PyTree, fake_out: PyTree, fake_in: PyTree, )
methods.description: Validates that real and fake outputs/inputs have consistent aliasing and identity relationships, raising MetadataMismatchError if mismatched.

methods.name: bool is_sdpa_error(func: OpOverload, idx: int, e: Exception)
methods.description: Detects specific errors related to SDPA (Sparse Dynamic Polyhedral Arrangements) in particular aten functions, based on exception messages.

methods.name: list[FakeTensor|torch.Tensor|Any] try_convert_fake_to_real( ten_list: list[FakeTensor | Any], )
methods.description: Attempts to convert FakeTensor objects in a list to real tensors with the same underlying storage, used for debugging or consistency checks.

methods.name: None _check_fake_real_tensors( real_out: torch.Tensor, fake_out: FakeTensor, context: str = "", sizes: bool = True, strides: bool = False, storage_offset: bool = True, requires_grad: bool = True, )
methods.description: Checks that fake and real tensors have consistent metadata such as requires_grad, storage offset, and shape attributes.

methods.name: None __init__( self, ignore_op_fn: Callable[[OpOverload], bool] | None = None, *, check_strides: bool = True, check_aliasing: bool = True, only_check_ops_with_meta: bool = True, )
object __torch_dispatch__( self, func: OpOverload, types: Sequence[type], args: Sequence[object] = (), kwargs: Mapping[str, object] | None = None, )
